name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(2.756)|0> and RY(0.708)|0>. Compare the estimate from 8192 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((2.756-0.708)/2). Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
